skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature, models, and principles of labor relations, including the roles and behaviors of stakeholders.
Understand and apply labor laws and regulations in organizational settings.
Analyze and resolve labor disputes effectively.
Facilitate and participate in social dialogue processes within organizations.
Conduct independent research and analyze data related to labor relations.
Evaluate and compare labor relations in different organizational and national contexts.
Effectively communicate and present findings on labor relations issues.
Work collaboratively in groups to solve labor relations problems.
Demonstrate professional ethics and responsibility in labor relations contexts.
